$comment: NOT a golden manifest. Each entry records how WRONG our ACTIVITY-engine SVG emission is today against the jar oracle under DeterministicMeasurer, measured by tests/oracle/svg-conformance/activity.diff-baseline.ratchet.test.ts over the committed corpus at test-results/dot-cache/activity/<slug>/{in.puml,in.svg} (D4/D1 -- no SVG is copied here). Rendered WITH the vendored-stdlib include store (tests/helpers/fixture-include-store.ts), the same seam every svg-conformance surface uses. Population: 373 committed activity fixtures (scripts/oracle-corpus.ts:58 idiom, plugin.type === 'activity', D3), of which 23 have a golden that is the jar's OWN graphical error page (PSystemError.java:148-155 / ReportLog.java:103-108) and record status:"jar-error" with NO weightedScore -- the jar failing is no evidence about us (D12). 90 have our OWN parser refusing the source (renderFixtureActivity throws) and record status:"error" with a reason, never a number (D8); 8 of those 90 overlap the 23 jar-error fixtures and are recorded as "jar-error" (D12: a fixture in BOTH exclusion sets records jar-error, since the jar's failure makes our own outcome unevidential either way). That leaves 268 status:"baseline" entries with a numeric weightedScore -- NOTE: the original T2 task spec and decisions.md D12's own arithmetic (373 - 23 - 90 + 8) both state this figure as 283; the literal arithmetic of that formula is 268, and 268 is what direct measurement over the committed corpus produces (23 jar-error, 82 error-only, 8 overlap, 268 baseline; 23+82+268=373). Flagged for review, not silently corrected: see T2's report. THE GATED QUANTITY IS weightedScore, NOT diffCount (D2, plans/sequence-root-chrome/decisions.md D5): compareNodes short-circuits on node-type, tag and child-count mismatch, charging exactly 1 for each however large the skipped subtree, so diffCount is NOT monotone in wrongness. weightedScore charges each short-circuit an upper bound on what descending could have cost, so it IS monotone in alignment and is what this ratchet gates. diffCount is kept as an INFORMATIONAL field only. A RISEN diffCount beside a FALLEN weightedScore after T5's chrome fix is the EXPECTED artefact of that weighting, not a failure -- see the $comment on this field in the sequence sibling for the full mechanism. Current state (T6, POST-chrome). T5 routed renderActivity through the klimt document shell (D6) and this baseline was re-pinned against it: aggregate weightedScore over the 268 fell 154722 -> 108447 (-29.9%), with 268 fixtures FALLING, ZERO rising and none unchanged. diffCount rose on 57 and fell on 211 -- the D2 artefact stated in advance, not a regression. T2's pre-chrome floor (238 of 268 at exactly diffCount=12, sharing one 12-path root-chrome set) is GONE: of that 12-path set only three paths survive anywhere in the corpus, each on exactly ONE fixture and each a VALUE difference rather than an absent attribute -- svg/@background on levuma-67-cego489 (skinparam mode dark: we resolve #FFFFFF, the jar #1B1B1B), svg/@preserveAspectRatio on setecu-78-cuko533 (unported skinparam preserveAspectRatio), and svg/defs[1][childCount] on dakesa-98-mano758 (a red-green gradient the jar expands into a <linearGradient>; OUR defs is the empty one there). Verified directly, not inferred from the diff set: all 268 emit all 7 root attributes and data-diagram-type="ACTIVITY", our defs is empty on all 268, and the jar's is non-empty on exactly 1. What remains is 91.6% svg/g[][childCount] weight -- 190 of 268 fixtures draw FEWER children than the jar, which is unported activity CONTENT, not chrome. weightedScore over the 268 now ranges min 17 (gonixe-93-zaza537) to max 2922 (jupoxe-15-sugo110), median 366. The full residual work queue, ranked by weight and carrying a per-fixture DIRECTION for the geometry residual (it goes both ways), is oracle/goldens/svg-activity/diff-census.json. Do not hand-edit weightedScore or diffCount to make the suite pass: re-run the measurement and change weightedScore, diffCount, measuredAt and measuredAgainstCommit together.
